hits.title: Centific Appoints Vasudevan Sundarababu as Chief Data and AI Officer
hits.snippet: [hires] Centific Global Solutions, Inc. hires Vasu as Senior Vice President and head of Digital Engineering. Vasu joined Centific in late 2021 as the Senior Vice President and head of Digital Engineering, bringing with him over 25 years of experience building AI and Data platforms.

hits.title: Centific Appoints Shiva Jayaraman as Chief Growth Officer to Harness Generative AI Demand for Accelerated Enterprise Growth
hits.snippet: [hires | 2024-05-21] Centific Global Solutions, Inc. hired Shiva Jayaraman as Chief Growth Officer on May 21st '24. REDMOND, Wash., May 21, 2024 /PRNewswire/ - Centific, a leading innovator in generative AI (GenAI), today announced the strategic appointment of Shiva Jayaraman as its new Chief Growth Officer (CGO).
hits.summary: Centific Global Solutions, Inc. hired Shiva Jayaraman as Chief Growth Officer on May 21st '24.
